name: All descending neurons (brain -> nerve cord)
function: The complete descending interface between brain and ventral nerve cord; 1,305 neurons of 473 types in v783 (all exit nerve CV).

name: Moonwalker descending neurons (MDN)
function: Bilateral command neurons for backward walking: optogenetic activation drives backward walking, silencing impairs it; also engaged by visual looming/escape.
references: Bidaye et al. 2014 (Science); Sen et al. 2017 (Cell Rep)

name: P9 / DNp09 descending neurons
function: Command neurons for forward walking with ipsilateral turning; receive major input from LC9 visual projection neurons and courtship circuitry; required for male pursuit.
references: Bidaye et al. 2020 (Neuron); Sapkal et al. 2024 (Nature)
proposed_mapping: FORWARD + ipsiversive TURN (left neuron -> turn left)

name: Bolt protocerebral neurons (BPN, types 1-4, central command)
function: Central-brain command neurons for straight, fast forward walking; BPN activation initiates/maintains straight walking; not required for courtship; feed major SEZ descending neurons.
references: Bidaye et al. 2020 (Neuron); author labels in FlyWire

name: Roadrunner neurons (RRN, CB0257 pair)
function: Bilateral pair of central brain neurons whose activation initiates forward walking and modulates walking speed; characterized as the dedicated forward-walking circuit together with their downstream leg DN cluster.

name: Leg descending-neuron cluster (Dallmann 2026 DN_leg_cluster)
function: The descending leg-control cluster (11 types) characterised downstream of the forward-walking command; carries the forward program to the legs.

name: Giant fibers (DNp01)
function: Command neuron pair of the escape jump / flight-startle pathway; driven by LPLC2+LC4 looming input; the fastest conductance route to jump motor programs.
references: King & Wyman 1980; von Reyn et al. 2017; Ache et al. 2019
proposed_mapping: STARTLE/JUMP (mapped to game jump/dash or emergency escape)

name: Foxglove (FG) halt neurons (CB0890)
function: GABAergic walk-OFF neuron pair that selectively inhibits forward-walking descending commands; activation halts forward walking (halting during feeding).
references: Sapkal et al. 2024 (Nature); Sterne et al. 2021

name: Bluebell (BB) halt neurons (DNg60)
function: GABAergic walk-OFF neuron pair that selectively inhibits turning-related walking commands; activation halts turning.
references: Sapkal et al. 2024 (Nature); Sterne et al. 2021

name: Brake neurons (BRK1-6, ascending)
region: VNC leg neuromeres -> brain SEZ (ascending axons)
function: Cholinergic ascending brake neurons; activation arrests stepping and stabilises joints; mutually exclusive with walk-OFF use; engage during grooming. Present in v783 via their ascending axons (AN_GNG_53/54/76).
proposed_mapping: STOP (active brake; VNC part not in brain-only connectome)

name: Brain motor neurons (incl. MN9/CB0701)
function: Final common-path motor neurons of the brain (proboscis, pharynx, head); MN9 (CB0701) is the tutorial readout used in Gate-1 evidence.
